name: repoplugin-task-contracts
description: Private task folders, artifact handoffs, and small lifecycle checks for the Repoplugin workflow suite.

interface.shortDescription: Private task folders and handoffs for suite routes.
interface.longDescription: Provides private skills and a small PowerShell helper for explicit task identity, contained artifacts, handoffs, completion, and validation. It exposes no public user route.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the owning Repoplugin route to create or attach an explicit repository task and preserve its artifacts.
